title: Smart Data Models - SAREF4GRID - MeterProperty
description: https://saref.etsi.org/saref4grid/MeterProperty. Class to group those properties related to electric grid meters. Subclass of saref:Property (core SAREF). Same general/specific-via-SKOS pattern as EnergyAndPowerProperty, scoped to meter (device-level, not power-line) properties; these are the properties a GridMeter links to via saref:hasPropertyValue.

id.description: Property. Unique identifier of the entity

type.description: Property. NGSI-LD Entity type. It must be equal to 'MeterProperty'

dateModified.description: Property. Model:'https://schema.org/DateTime'. Timestamp of the last modification.

source.description: Property. A sequence of characters giving the source of the entity data.

dataProvider.description: Property. A sequence of characters identifying the provider of the harmonised data entity.

propertyType.description: Property. The specific kind of meter property this instance represents, drawn from the SAREF4GRID controlled vocabulary of named MeterProperty individuals (the 'general' properties of Figure 6 of the specification).

broaderPropertyType.description: Property (skos:broader). When this instance represents a specific, narrower, OBIS-identified property (e.g. 'ActivePowerLimitContract1TariffPeriod1'), this names the general MeterProperty individual it specializes.

hasObis.description: Property. [COSEM/IEC 62056] OBIS code identifying this meter property instance.

unitOfMeasure.description: Property. Unit of measure of the property's values, where defined (e.g. om:watt). Notice that some meter properties do not specify a unit of measure.
